text:
interesting video with strengths and limits

Strenghts... this is an effective MCP Demonstration: an excellent example of leveraging MCP to turn an LLM harness into a headless creative agency capable of reading design guidelines, calling media APIs and outputting production code/media files in a unified local workspace. Important context preservation note... by placing brand bibles and asset references in your local directories you prevent the AI from defaulting to AI slop.

Now the limitations & caveats!
Localhost vs. Production: note the output website runs locally on Node/Vercel frameworks and deploying to production still requires standard git commits and continuous integration setups. So what? Well running high-res video models (like SeaDance 2.5 or Sora) repeatedly across multiple ad iterations via API calls will quickly consume substantial Higsfield platform credits. Just be aware of that...
